taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.source_trace: Trace input bytes through format detection, decompression, nested decoding and runtime object/type construction. Record trust/signature checks before deserialization and available type restrictions.
controls.controlled_verification: In an isolated fixture use an inert type/constructor marker to determine whether caller-selected types or hooks are instantiated. Inspect formats statically when loading would run code; gadget execution is unnecessary to prove an unsafe trust boundary.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: JSON parsing into plain data is not automatically unsafe deserialization. A signed envelope only changes the conclusion if signature verification and the authorized producer boundary actually protect these exact bytes before loading.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use a data-only format or supported restricted loading with explicit schema/type authority. Retest normal data, rejected unexpected types and nested decoder paths.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
